data:
front: migrate songbook UI to DB-backed Chord API

Update the songbook frontend to use the DB-backed chords API:
- RawChord/Chord types updated for the new Chord shape
- api layer uses addEntry instead of updateAll/getLinksVisitsCount
- uploadNewChord simplified to call addEntry directly
- drop client-side creationDate from the add-song form payload
- visit counts sourced from getAll instead of getLinksVisitsCount
- use creationDateUnix (seconds) in LatestAdditions
- replace the JSON editor with a read-only chords table on the edit
  page, and drop the now-unused svelte-jsoneditor dependency

Includes the design spec and implementation plan for this migration.
